newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PALERMO THANK PATRON SAINT FOR KEY WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PALERMO THANK PATRON SAINT FOR KEY WIN.

text.p: The top executives and coach of Italian second division soccer club Palermo made a pilgrimage to thank the Sicilian capital's patron saint for a key victory.

Palermo chairman Giovanni Ferrara, coach Ignazio Arcoleo and two managers hiked five kilometres (three miles) up the city's steep Mount Pellegrino to show their gratitude before a statue of Saint Rosalia at the top, newspapers said.
They were fulfilling a promise to make the pilgrimage if Palermo beat leading side Brescia at home to pull out of the relegation zone on Sunday. The Sicilians won 3-2.
"It was a way of keeping in shape, just like any other," a smiling Arcoleo told reporters.
